page.layout: One text column, full width. No margin notes. Running head at top, page number at top right. Signature "Cc" below the last line, right of centre.

main_text.l: tus siquidem hoc tantum observat Va-
lentinum Vnigenitum distinxisse à Ver-
bo, Verbum à Christo, Christum à Iesu,
idémque fecisse Basilidem, sed de Verbi à
Monogene educatione penitus tacet. At
Irenæus, inquit, de Basilide ita loquitur
lib. 1 cap. 23. ostendit Nun primò ab Innato

l.i: natum Patre, ab hoc autem natum Logon;

main_text.l: fateor hæc de Basilide scripsisse Irenæum,
hisque similia de eodem tradere Epipha-
nium & Theodoretum, sed ista Viri docti
causam minimè iuvant, nulla siquidem
Siges fit mentio inter Basilidis figmenta,
docebat quidem Basilides à Nu natum Lo-
gon, sed à Nu & Sige emissum esse nus-
quam docuit; primus ex Gnosticis hoc af-
feruit Valentinus, nullusque ante eum
Logi ex Sige emanationem commentus
est; Basilides, ait Pearsonius p. 65. & illi

l.i: Gnostici inter quos ipse fuit, neque Bython ne-
que Nun sine συζύγοις suis Æonem ullum pro-

main_text.l: creâsse docuerunt[?]. Cùm hæc lego, vix ocu-
lis meis credo, contraria prorsus à vetu-
stioribus Ecclesiæ Scriptoribus edoctus;
Nam Irenæus, Tertullianus, Philastrius,
Epiphanius, Theodoretus, fabulosam
Basilidis Theogoniam sic repræsentant;

page.notes: The word "tus" at the top is a fragment carried over from the previous page. A stain covers the end of "docuerunt" and the start of "procreâsse"; the reading is doubtful. The Greek "συζύγοις" is small and faint, so its accents are doubtful. The final "&c" at the line end is partly unclear. The page number and running head are printed at the top. The signature "Cc" is at the foot.
